attchmntText: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited published un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 5, 2026. The announcement was published in newspapers on November 7, 2026. Kamdhenu Ventures Limited issued a notice regarding a Postal Ballot. The e-voting period commenced on November 7, 2026, and ends on December 6, 2026. The cut-off date for voting eligibility is November 4, 2026. Shri Rupesh Agarwal is the scrutinizer. Results will be announced by December 8, 2026. Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 5, 2026. BF Utilities Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 6, 2026.

attchmntText: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding '' Single lowest bidder for a work under Eastern Railway, Sealdah Division".

BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "on the Un-audited Financial Results (standalone & consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026".
BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
